parsed.rationale: All four records are empty interfaces (fields_or_signature: [], shared_field_count: 2 shared structural slots) spread across four packages — Playback, Wallpaper, MusicShareKit, and Analytics. A dedicated Analytics package already exists at Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift and defines AnalyticsEvent, making it the natural canonical parent. PlaybackAnalyticsEvent, QualityAnalyticsEvent, and RequestLineAnalyticsEvent are domain-scoped refinements of the same concept and should inherit from AnalyticsEvent rather than independently redeclaring an identical empty protocol shape. This eliminates the structural duplication while preserving each package's ability to constrain its own event type.
